mapper.insert: INSERT INTO example_enrichment_tasks(entry_type, entry_id, status) VALUES(#{entryType}, #{entryId}, 'PENDING') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = 'PENDING', attempt_count = 0, last_error = NULL, locked_at = NULL, finished_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT IGNORE INTO example_enrichment_tasks(entry_type, entry_id, status) SELECT 'PUBLIC', v.id, 'PENDING' FROM public_vocabulary_entries v JOIN ( SELECT id FROM public_vocabulary_entries ORDER BY CASE WHEN bnc_rank IS NOT NULL AND bnc_rank > 0 THEN bnc_rank ELSE 999999999 END ASC, CASE WHEN frq_rank IS NOT NULL AND frq_rank > 0 THEN frq_rank ELSE 999999999 END ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{publicLimit} ) ranked_public_entries ON ranked_public_entries.id = v.id LEFT JOIN example_enrichment_tasks t ON t.entry_type = 'PUBLIC' AND t.entry_id = v.id WHERE t.id IS NULL AND ( v.corrected_english IS NULL OR v.corrected_english = '' OR v.chinese_sentence IS NULL OR v.chinese_sentence = '' OR v.example_audio_url IS NULL OR v.example_audio_url = '' OR LOWER(TRIM(v.corrected_english)) REGEXP '^(n|v|vt|vi|adj|adv|prep|pron|conj|art|aux|num|int|det|abbr|phr|pref|suf|modal)\\.' OR LOWER(TRIM(v.corrected_english)) = LOWER(TRIM(v.word)) OR TRIM(v.corrected_english) NOT LIKE '% %' OR LOWER(v.corrected_english) NOT LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(v.word), '%') OR v.corrected_english NOT REGEXP '[A-Za-z]' ) ORDER BY v.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

INSERT IGNORE INTO example_enrichment_tasks(entry_type, entry_id, status) SELECT 'USER', v.id, 'PENDING' FROM user_vocabulary_entries v LEFT JOIN example_enrichment_tasks t ON t.entry_type = 'USER' AND t.entry_id = v.id WHERE t.id IS NULL AND ( v.corrected_english IS NULL OR v.corrected_english = '' OR v.chinese_sentence IS NULL OR v.chinese_sentence = '' ) ORDER BY v.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE example_enrichment_tasks SET status = 'PENDING', attempt_count = 0, last_error = NULL, locked_at = NULL, finished_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id IN ( SELECT task_id FROM ( SELECT t.id AS task_id FROM example_enrichment_tasks t JOIN public_vocabulary_entries v ON v.id = t.entry_id AND t.entry_type = 'PUBLIC' JOIN ( SELECT id FROM public_vocabulary_entries ORDER BY CASE WHEN bnc_rank IS NOT NULL AND bnc_rank > 0 THEN bnc_rank ELSE 999999999 END ASC, CASE WHEN frq_rank IS NOT NULL AND frq_rank > 0 THEN frq_rank ELSE 999999999 END ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{publicLimit} ) ranked_public_entries ON ranked_public_entries.id = v.id WHERE t.status IN ('FAILED', 'SKIPPED', 'SUCCEEDED') AND ( v.corrected_english IS NULL OR v.corrected_english = '' OR v.chinese_sentence IS NULL OR v.chinese_sentence = '' OR v.example_audio_url IS NULL OR v.example_audio_url = '' OR LOWER(TRIM(v.corrected_english)) REGEXP '^(n|v|vt|vi|adj|adv|prep|pron|conj|art|aux|num|int|det|abbr|phr|pref|suf|modal)\\.' OR LOWER(TRIM(v.corrected_english)) = LOWER(TRIM(v.word)) OR TRIM(v.corrected_english) NOT LIKE '% %' OR LOWER(v.corrected_english) NOT LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(v.word), '%') OR v.corrected_english NOT REGEXP '[A-Za-z]' ) ORDER BY t.id ASC LIMIT #{limit} ) pending_task_ids )

UPDATE example_enrichment_tasks t JOIN public_vocabulary_entries v ON v.id = t.entry_id AND t.entry_type = 'PUBLIC' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT id FROM public_vocabulary_entries ORDER BY CASE WHEN bnc_rank IS NOT NULL AND bnc_rank > 0 THEN bnc_rank ELSE 999999999 END ASC, CASE WHEN frq_rank IS NOT NULL AND frq_rank > 0 THEN frq_rank ELSE 999999999 END ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{publicLimit} ) ranked_public_entries ON ranked_public_entries.id = v.id SET t.status = 'SKIPPED', t.last_error = 'OUT_OF_PUBLIC_TOP_LIMIT', t.locked_at = NULL, t.finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, t.updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ranked_public_entries.id IS NULL AND t.status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING', 'FAILED') AND ( v.corrected_english IS NULL OR v.corrected_english = '' OR v.chinese_sentence IS NULL OR v.chinese_sentence = '' OR v.example_audio_url IS NULL OR v.example_audio_url = '' OR LOWER(TRIM(v.corrected_english)) REGEXP '^(n|v|vt|vi|adj|adv|prep|pron|conj|art|aux|num|int|det|abbr|phr|pref|suf|modal)\\.' OR LOWER(TRIM(v.corrected_english)) = LOWER(TRIM(v.word)) OR TRIM(v.corrected_english) NOT LIKE '% %' OR LOWER(v.corrected_english) NOT LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(v.word), '%') OR v.corrected_english NOT REGEXP '[A-Za-z]' )

UPDATE example_enrichment_tasks SET status = 'PENDING', locked_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND locked_at IS NOT NULL AND locked_at <= TIMESTAMPADD(MINUTE, -#{timeoutMinutes}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT id, entry_type, entry_id, status, attempt_count, last_error FROM example_enrichment_tasks WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND attempt_count < #{maxRetries} ORDER BY CASE WHEN status = 'FAILED' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, updated_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT t.id, t.entry_type, t.entry_id, t.status, t.attempt_count, t.last_error FROM example_enrichment_tasks t JOIN public_vocabulary_entries v ON v.id = t.entry_id JOIN ( SELECT id FROM public_vocabulary_entries ORDER BY
created_at DESC, id DESC
created_at ASC, id ASC
LIMIT #{audioScopeLimit} ) scoped_public_entries ON scoped_public_entries.id = v.id WHERE t.entry_type = 'PUBLIC' AND t.status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND t.attempt_count < #{maxRetries} AND v.corrected_english IS NOT NULL AND v.corrected_english != '' AND v.chinese_sentence IS NOT NULL AND v.chinese_sentence != '' AND LOWER(TRIM(v.corrected_english)) NOT REGEXP '^(n|v|vt|vi|adj|adv|prep|pron|conj|art|aux|num|int|det|abbr|phr|pref|suf|modal)\\.' AND LOWER(TRIM(v.corrected_english)) != LOWER(TRIM(v.word)) AND TRIM(v.corrected_english) LIKE '% %' AND LOWER(v.corrected_english) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(v.word), '%') AND v.corrected_english REGEXP '[A-Za-z]' ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, t.updated_at ASC, t.entry_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT t.id, t.entry_type, t.entry_id, t.status, t.attempt_count, t.last_error FROM example_enrichment_tasks t JOIN public_vocabulary_entries v ON v.id = t.entry_id JOIN ( SELECT id FROM public_vocabulary_entries ORDER BY CASE WHEN bnc_rank IS NOT NULL AND bnc_rank > 0 THEN bnc_rank ELSE 999999999 END ASC, CASE WHEN frq_rank IS NOT NULL AND frq_rank > 0 THEN frq_rank ELSE 999999999 END ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{publicLimit} ) scoped_public_entries ON scoped_public_entries.id = v.id WHERE t.entry_type = 'PUBLIC' AND t.status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND t.attempt_count < #{maxRetries} AND ( v.corrected_english IS NULL OR v.corrected_english = '' OR v.chinese_sentence IS NULL OR v.chinese_sentence = '' OR LOWER(TRIM(v.corrected_english)) REGEXP '^(n|v|vt|vi|adj|adv|prep|pron|conj|art|aux|num|int|det|abbr|phr|pref|suf|modal)\\.' OR LOWER(TRIM(v.corrected_english)) = LOWER(TRIM(v.word)) OR TRIM(v.corrected_english) NOT LIKE '% %' OR LOWER(v.corrected_english) NOT LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(v.word), '%') OR v.corrected_english NOT REGEXP '[A-Za-z]' ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.status = 'FAILED' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, t.updated_at ASC, t.entry_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE example_enrichment_tasks SET status = 'RUNNING', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, last_error = NULL, locked_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, finished_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND attempt_count < #{maxRetries}
UPDATE example_enrichment_tasks SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', last_error = NULL, locked_at = NULL, finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{taskId}
UPDATE example_enrichment_tasks SET status = 'SKIPPED', last_error = #{lastError}, locked_at = NULL, finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{taskId}
UPDATE example_enrichment_tasks SET status = 'FAILED', last_error = #{lastError}, locked_at = NULL, finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{taskId}
